source.title: ASOIAF Timeline - Vandal Proof
source.classification: Fan-made estimates; not canonical geography or chronology
source.import_scope: Numeric road, sea and raven matrices and labeled road pace rows only. Timeline, plot notes and unnamed route stubs are excluded.

units.basis: The road speed sheet explicitly labels distance in miles and uses 680 for Castle Black to Winterfell, matching the road matrix. The matrix titles omit units; treating sea and raven matrix numbers as miles is an explicit campaign convention consistent with the workbook's mpd rates, not a verified statement in those headers.

assumptions: Route mileage is treated as symmetric; travel time, access and conditions are not.
Cells are preserved as supplied, even when they conflict with other routes. No shortest-path recalculation or silent corrections.
Workbook travel speeds are estimates and require a suitable party, pace, conditions and means; the source warns that fast paces have limited endurance.
Raven distance does not establish a trained bird's destination, availability, successful delivery or recipient knowledge.
Sea distance does not establish ship availability, sailing conditions or embarkation time. Supply an explicit speed assumption for sea or raven estimates.
Estimates do not advance campaign time or guarantee uninterrupted travel.
One numeric row in the road speed sheet has no travel-mode label and was not assigned an invented profile.
